request.initial_prompt: And the son has seen and known all this—he is a ruined man, and his fear has taught him to knock ambition and passion headforemost from his bosom's throne; humbled by poverty he takes to money-making and by mean and miserly savings and hard work gets a fortune together. Is not such an one likely to seat the concupiscent and covetous element on the vacant throne and to suffer it to play the great king within him, girt with tiara and chain and scimitar?

raw_segments.text: And the son has seen and known all this—he is a ruined man, and his fear has taught him
to knock ambition and passion headforemost from his bosom's throne. Humbled by poverty
he takes to money-making and by mean and miserly savings and hard work gets a fortune together.
Is not such an one likely to seat the concupiscent and covetous element on the vacant throne
and to suffer it to play the great king within him, girt with tiara and chain and scimitar?
